contentBlocks.text: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਨਾਂਵ, ਕਿਰਿਆ, ਅਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ਣ ਸਿੱਖੇ। ਅੱਜ ਇੱਕ ਨਵਾਂ ਸ਼ਬਦ-ਕਿਸਮ: ਪੜਨਾਂਵ! (Last week you learned nouns, verbs, and adjectives. Today, a new word type: pronouns!)

A pronoun replaces a noun so you don't have to repeat a name every time. ਮੈਂ means 'I' (talking about yourself), ਤੂੰ means 'you' (talking to someone), and ਉਹ means 'he' or 'she' (talking about someone else). Instead of saying a friend's name every time, you can say ਉਹ. Practice: say 'ਮੈਂ ਖੇਡਦਾ ਹਾਂ' (I play, for a boy) or 'ਮੈਂ ਖੇਡਦੀ ਹਾਂ' (I play, for a girl) about yourself.
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਪੜਨਾਂਵ ਸਿੱਖੇ! (You just learned pronouns!) Tomorrow we'll learn how to make a noun plural — more than one.

objectives: Learn 3 personal pronouns: ਮੈਂ (I), ਤੂੰ (you), ਉਹ (he/she)
Use ਮੈਂ correctly with the matching gendered verb form in a self-referential sentence
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review last week's nouns/verbs/adjectives briefly.
2. Introduce the 3 pronouns and what a pronoun does.
3. Have the child say 'ਮੈਂ ਖੇਡਦਾ/ਖੇਡਦੀ ਹਾਂ' about themselves.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's plural-nouns lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just ਮੈਂ first, since it's the pronoun the child will use most in self-referential sentences
Ready for more: ask the child to use ਉਹ in a sentence about a friend or family member
Point out explicitly that pronouns save you from repeating the same name over and over — a real, motivating reason to learn them
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a vocabulary-acquisition activity — check that the child correctly traces/writes all 3 pronouns and uses ਮੈਂ with the gender-matching verb form for themselves.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'grammar basics' goal by introducing pronouns as a genuinely new part of speech beyond last week's nouns/verbs/adjectives.

generationData.instructions: Trace each word, then copy it once on your own.
